THE GRAIN STORE - Harlow & Pike Mills staff newsletter - October 2026

Hello everyone, and welcome to the autumn edition. It's been a busy harvest
season and the new flaking line at the Pike site is finally running at full
speed - thank you to everyone who put in extra shifts in September.

NEW HIRING POLICY FROM 1 NOVEMBER
A lot of you have asked about this, so here's the short version. From next
month, every open role will be posted internally for one week before it goes
to agencies or job boards. Shortlists will have at least two interviewers,
and we're dropping the requirement for a degree on most supervisor roles -
relevant experience will count instead. The full policy is on the HR
noticeboard and the intranet. Questions to Gemma in People Team.

MEET THE NEW FACES
We welcomed six new starters this month, including Tunde in maintenance and
Charlotte, our new food safety lead, who joins us from a dairy in Cheshire.

SAFETY CORNER
212 days without a lost-time accident at Harlow. Pike is at 87. Remember:
ear defenders are mandatory beyond the yellow line in the milling hall.

DATES FOR YOUR DIARY
  - 24 Oct: Bake-off in the canteen (entries to Sam by the 20th)
  - 6 Nov: Flu jabs on site, 9am-1pm
  - 12 Dec: Christmas party, Riverside Hotel

That's all for this month. Got a story for the next issue? Drop it in the
box by reception.
